channels.title: California E-Bike Incentive Project
channels.description:
https://www.ebikeincentives.org/

The California E-Bike Incentive Project provides up to $2,000 of point-of-sale incentives to support the purchase of a new electric bicycle (e-bike).

The California E-Bike Incentive Project is a partnership between California Air Resources Board and Pedal Ahead.

This Project is part of California Climate Investments, a statewide program that puts billions of Cap-and-Trade dollars to work reducing greenhouse gas emissions, strengthening the economy, and improving public health and the environment particularly in disadvantaged communities.
